question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Tedious
solution:
The correct answer is Option no. **(1)** '**Tiresome'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'Tedious'** means too long, slow, or dull; tiresome or monotonous.(थकाऊ)

 
 
• **Example:**- The journey was too much tedious.
 
 
 
• The word** 'Tiresome' **means causing one to feel bored or annoyed. (थकाने वाला)
 
 
• **Example:-** Weeding is a tiresome but essential job.
 
 

As both the words Tiresome and Tedious are similar in meaning.

Therefore,the correct answer is option no.**(1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Other options are:**

 
 
• **Wholesome- **conducive to or suggestive of good health and physical well-being.**(लाभदायक)**
 
• **Repetitive- **containing or characterized by repetition, especially when unnecessary or tiresome.**(दुहराना/दुहराया हुआ)**
 
• **Threescore- **being three times twenty;sixty.**(साठ)**
 
 

33:T983,

The correct answer is Option no. (2) '
